title: 15 head-to-heads that reveal which stock an AI picks, from Nvidia vsAmerican Express to Eli Lilly vs Tesla. Which side would you take?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
15 fresh head-to-heads just dropped, and some are wild pairings:  
Nvidia vs American Express, Eli Lilly vs Tesla, Robinhood vs Tesla.  
Meta is growing revenue about 26% vs about 12% for Spotify, and  
Amazon's AWS just grew about 39%. The AI picked a side in every one.  
Can you guess them before you click?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. AXP vs NVDA\*\* — A defensive card giant vs the AI chip king, which  
now carries a leadership and governance overhang. Which one does the  
AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/american-express-axp-vs-nvidia-nvda-weighing-stability-against-high-growth-volatility-39742/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/american-express-axp-vs-nvidia-nvda-weighing-stability-against-high-growth-volatility-39742/)  
  
\*\*2. AMZN vs O\*\* — AWS just grew about 39%, its fastest pace in nearly  
five years. Realty Income is the monthly-dividend landlord. Growth vs  
income. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/amazon-amzn-vs-realty-income-o-growth-momentum-meets-income-stability-39737/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/amazon-amzn-vs-realty-income-o-growth-momentum-meets-income-stability-39737/)  
  
\*\*3. EPAM vs IBM\*\* — IBM is roughly 30x EPAM's market cap, but EPAM  
just rallied on an expanded buyback and an earnings beat. Which one  
does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/epam-vs-ibm-weighing-momentum-against-stability-in-tech-services-39732/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/epam-vs-ibm-weighing-momentum-against-stability-in-tech-services-39732/)  
  
\*\*4. EL vs ELF\*\* — A margin-led turnaround vs a much faster grower  
whose growth leans on acquisitions and tariffs. Which one does the AI  
favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/est-e-lauder-el-vs-e-l-f-beauty-elf-margin-recovery-meets-high-growth-ambition-39731/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/est-e-lauder-el-vs-e-l-f-beauty-elf-margin-recovery-meets-high-growth-ambition-39731/)  
  
\*\*5. NET vs DDOG\*\* — Datadog beat with 35% revenue growth, then guided  
next quarter roughly flat and sold off. Cloudflare raised guidance.  
Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/cloudflare-net-vs-datadog-ddog-net-holds-the-edge-on-recent-momentum-39714/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/cloudflare-net-vs-datadog-ddog-net-holds-the-edge-on-recent-momentum-39714/)  
  
\*\*6. CG vs KKR\*\* — About $800B in AUM plus an insurance arm vs about  
$479B and stronger recent inflows. Which one does the AI favor? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/cg-vs-kkr-carlyle-s-momentum-and-inflows-compared-to-kkr-s-scale-39584/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/cg-vs-kkr-carlyle-s-momentum-and-inflows-compared-to-kkr-s-scale-39584/)  
  
\*\*7. APLD vs CRDO\*\* — An unprofitable, debt-heavy AI data center  
builder vs the company selling the high-speed links that wire those  
data centers. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the  
link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/applied-digital-apld-vs-credo-technology-crdo-weighing-two-ai-infrastructure-bets-39566/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/applied-digital-apld-vs-credo-technology-crdo-weighing-two-ai-infrastructure-bets-39566/)  
  
\*\*8. ASX vs TSM\*\* — The world's largest chip packaging and testing  
house vs the world's leading foundry. Both ride the AI buildout. Which  
one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/asx-vs-tsm-momentum-in-advanced-packaging-favors-asx-over-the-dominant-foundry-39563/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/asx-vs-tsm-momentum-in-advanced-packaging-favors-asx-over-the-dominant-foundry-39563/)  
  
\*\*9. AVGO vs LLY\*\* — AI chips vs GLP-1 drugs. Mounjaro and Zepbound  
sales more than doubled, and Broadcom's AI revenue is accelerating.  
Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/avgo-vs-lly-ai-chip-momentum-meets-glp-1-drug-growth-39558/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/avgo-vs-lly-ai-chip-momentum-meets-glp-1-drug-growth-39558/)  
  
\*\*10. LLY vs TSLA\*\* — Record highs on weight-loss drugs vs a stock  
that's down year to date and swings on robotaxi headlines. Which one  
does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/eli-lilly-lly-vs-tesla-tsla-weighing-stability-against-high-growth-volatility-39527/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/eli-lilly-lly-vs-tesla-tsla-weighing-stability-against-high-growth-volatility-39527/)  
  
\*\*11. HOOD vs TSLA\*\* — Record revenue and a record subscriber base vs  
Tesla's robotaxi and growth story. Which one does the AI favor? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/robinhood-hood-vs-tesla-tsla-why-the-data-favors-hood-in-this-head-to-head-39515/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/robinhood-hood-vs-tesla-tsla-why-the-data-favors-hood-in-this-head-to-head-39515/)  
  
\*\*12. META vs SPOT\*\* — Revenue growth of about 26% vs about 12%. Both  
are betting on AI, in very different ways. Which one does the AI  
favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/meta-vs-spot-contrasting-growth-paths-in-the-communication-services-sector-39530/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/meta-vs-spot-contrasting-growth-paths-in-the-communication-services-sector-39530/)  
  
\*\*13. KDP vs KO\*\* — 8.6% constant-currency sales growth plus a pending  
JDE Peet's deal vs Coca-Cola's scale, after a revenue miss. Which one  
does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/kdp-vs-ko-weighing-keurig-dr-pepper-s-momentum-against-coca-cola-s-scale-39487/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/kdp-vs-ko-weighing-keurig-dr-pepper-s-momentum-against-coca-cola-s-scale-39487/)  
  
\*\*14. CVX vs PBR\*\* — 39 straight years of dividend raises vs record  
production at a cheaper valuation, with political risk attached. Which  
one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/cvx-vs-pbr-weighing-chevron-and-petrobras-for-energy-exposure-39538/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/cvx-vs-pbr-weighing-chevron-and-petrobras-for-energy-exposure-39538/)  
  
\*\*15. HUT vs IREN\*\* — Two former bitcoin miners turning into AI data  
center plays: a funded, leased model vs a faster, more capital-hungry  
build. Which one does the AI favor? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/hut-vs-iren-two-bitcoin-miners-navigating-the-shift-to-ai-infrastructure-39898/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/hut-vs-iren-two-bitcoin-miners-navigating-the-shift-to-ai-infrastructure-39898/)  
  
Which matchup would you call differently than the AI? Click through to  
see its pick in each.  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
